milestone:review.title: The named approver accepts the milestone
milestone:review.body:
### 2026-10-08: The named approver accepts the milestone

**Scope:** expert-role

**Workflows:** program-delivery

**Triggers:** milestone:review

**Captured:** 2026-10-08

**Source:** starter pack

**Rule:** A milestone is accepted only by the named approver.

**Why:** The program manager prepares the evidence. Acceptance is a separate act.

**How to apply:** Record the approver's yes in the verification file. Do not write accepted on your own authority.

milestone:review.title: State which milestone moved
milestone:review.body:
### 2026-10-08: State which milestone moved

**Scope:** expert-role

**Workflows:** program-escalation

**Triggers:** milestone:review

**Captured:** 2026-10-08

**Source:** starter pack

**Rule:** The assessment names the milestone that moved and why.

**Why:** Steering cannot decide from a vague slip.

**How to apply:** Name the milestone, the old date, and the pressure on the new date.

raid:update.title: Every risk has an owner and a date
raid:update.body:
### 2026-10-08: Every risk has an owner and a date

**Scope:** expert-role

**Workflows:** program-delivery

**Triggers:** raid:update

**Captured:** 2026-10-08

**Source:** starter pack

**Rule:** Every RAID entry has one owner and a date.

**Why:** An ownerless risk is a wish.

**How to apply:** Do not save a RAID entry that lacks either field.

raid:update.title: Watch the dependency after the decision
raid:update.body:
### 2026-10-08: Watch the dependency after the decision

**Scope:** expert-role

**Workflows:** program-escalation

**Triggers:** raid:update

**Captured:** 2026-10-08

**Source:** starter pack

**Rule:** Monitoring names the dependency or milestone signal and the next check.

**Why:** A decided escalation can slip again quietly.

**How to apply:** Record the signal and the check time.

scope:change.title: Scope changes use the change gate
scope:change.body:
### 2026-10-08: Scope changes use the change gate

**Scope:** expert-role

**Workflows:** program-delivery

**Triggers:** scope:change

**Captured:** 2026-10-08

**Source:** starter pack

**Rule:** A change to scope, date, or a dependency goes through change-request and waits for I approve the change or Skip change approval.

**Why:** Silent scope change breaks the charter.

**How to apply:** Draft the change file. Stop until the operator approves or skips.

scope:change.title: Response approval comes first
scope:change.body:
### 2026-10-08: Response approval comes first

**Scope:** expert-role

**Workflows:** program-escalation

**Triggers:** scope:change

**Captured:** 2026-10-08

**Source:** starter pack

**Rule:** Do not change scope, a date, or a dependency as part of an escalation response until the operator approves the response.

**Why:** Urgent disputes still need an explicit yes.

**How to apply:** Wait for I approve the response or Skip response approval.

status:report.title: Status is done, next, and blocked
status:report.body:
### 2026-10-08: Status is done, next, and blocked

**Scope:** expert-role

**Workflows:** program-delivery

**Triggers:** status:report

**Captured:** 2026-10-08

**Source:** starter pack

**Rule:** Every status report separates done, next, and blocked.

**Why:** Mixed status hides the blocked work.

**How to apply:** Use those three headings and no other structure for the status body.

steering:pack.title: Steering packs match the plan
steering:pack.body:
### 2026-10-08: Steering packs match the plan

**Scope:** expert-role

**Workflows:** program-delivery

**Triggers:** steering:pack

**Captured:** 2026-10-08

**Source:** starter pack

**Rule:** A steering pack uses the milestones, RAID, and decision rights from the approved plan.

**Why:** A pack that invents a new plan confuses governance.

**How to apply:** Read the operating plan first. Cite the milestone and the risk you are showing.

steering:pack.title: List options and the decider
steering:pack.body:
### 2026-10-08: List options and the decider

**Scope:** expert-role

**Workflows:** program-escalation

**Triggers:** steering:pack

**Captured:** 2026-10-08

**Source:** starter pack

**Rule:** The impact note lists options and who must decide.

**Why:** An escalation without a decider stalls.

**How to apply:** Write the options and one decider before asking for response approval.

steering:pack.title: Tell steering what was decided
steering:pack.body:
### 2026-10-08: Tell steering what was decided

**Scope:** expert-role

**Workflows:** program-escalation

**Triggers:** steering:pack

**Captured:** 2026-10-08

**Source:** starter pack

**Rule:** The response states what steering is told.

**Why:** Governance that hears nothing will reopen the decision.

**How to apply:** Write the message and the forum into the response.
